scope: PR-158 agent-skills vendoring + lifecycle-skill encouragement + auto-update mechanism

idea_refine_output.how_might_we: How might we make agent-skills + lifecycle-skill encouragement reproducible, fresh, and useful as part of ONE bootstrap — without user-level state, drift bugs, or upstream coupling we cannot roll back?

sharpening_answers.audience: Contributors who clone the repo + AI agents (Claude/Codex/Gemini/OpenCode) that operate inside it
success_criteria: Single command: `./tools/hook-bootstrap/install.sh` produces a fully-skilled environment
Agents discover the right lifecycle skill for the task automatically via SessionStart payload
Upstream drift caught daily and reviewed via PR (never silent)
Zero user-level state — clone + bootstrap + uninstall round-trips to clean repo state
Offline-tolerant — `--skip-skills` flag for contributors without network at install time
constraints: MIT license attribution preserved verbatim (LICENSE + UPSTREAM.json.attribution)
Multi-tool (Claude/Codex/Gemini/OpenCode) — honor upstream's multi-format skill content
sharpening_answers.what_been_tried: User-level plugin install (`agent-skills@addy-agent-skills: true` in ~/.claude/settings.json) — violates reproducibility per `if it's not in repo and reproducible, get rid of it`
sharpening_answers.why_now: PR-158 bootstrap in flight; perfect moment to fold this scope in as same install.sh additions rather than separate PR

A_vendor_plus_auto_PR_on_drift.feasibility: high — already half-built; addyosmani has validate-skills.js we can reuse verbatim
A_vendor_plus_auto_PR_on_drift.differentiation: provenance + sync workflow is novel; most vendor-and-forget

B_plugin_marketplace_no_vendor.killed_by: Reproducibility doctrine + multi-tool support requirement (Codex/Gemini/OpenCode get nothing); user-level state

C_git_submodule.killed_by: --recursive footgun, CI complexity, harder to drop our own _canonical-primitives.md alongside without polluting submodule

hidden_assumptions.validation: Run in CI on first install; if breaks, do not auto-PR — open ISSUE instead

hidden_assumptions.assumption: Vendor ALL skills, not curated subset
hidden_assumptions.validation: Simplicity beats curation; users ignore unused at runtime; downstream addition cost is zero

hidden_assumptions.validation: MIT § requires verbatim license inclusion; we ship LICENSE; satisfied
UPSTREAM.json captures URL; if moves, sync PR fails noisily — manual update of UPSTREAM.json triggers reconciliation

not_doing_and_why: Plugin marketplace dependency — violates reproducibility, multi-tool block
Git submodule — contributor friction, CI complexity
Forking + customizing per-skill — silent upstream drift
Cross-vendor aggregator (Anthropic-skills + others) — premature; build when 2nd vendor emerges at quality bar
Auto-merging sync PRs — review IS the audit point; never auto-merge upstream content

shift_left_on_PR_touching_vendor_or_boot.trigger: push/PR touching tools/agent-skills/** OR tools/hook-bootstrap/** OR tools/hooks/** OR bin/oya

gates_in_order.what_it_checks: Skill frontmatter + structure + cross-refs per upstream's own tests
Idempotency + dry-run output sane + no destructive ops on dry-run path

shift_left_on_PR_touching_vendor_or_boot.no_skip_policy: Even doc-only PRs touching this directory get the full validation set. No --no-verify bypass.

jobs.name: check-upstream
jobs.what: Fetch addyosmani HEAD SHA → compare with tools/agent-skills/UPSTREAM.json.commit_sha → output drift: true|false

jobs.name: validate-vendored
jobs.what: Run upstream validate-skills.js against current vendored content (catches drift bugs early — if upstream broke something, we know before re-vendoring)

jobs.name: open-sync-pr
jobs.what: Re-vendor, update UPSTREAM.json (new SHA + fetched_at), create branch chore/sync-agent-skills-<sha>, open PR with diff + upstream changelog link

jobs.name: open-issue-if-broken
jobs.what: Open ISSUE (not PR) with upstream commit range + validation output; pin requests user attention before re-vendoring; do not silently propagate broken upstream

scheduled_upstream_sync.honesty_principle: Never auto-PR a broken vendor. Issue > silent green.

feedback_loop_to_agents.pattern: When validate-skills.js fails in CI, the failure output goes to PR comments — next agent run reads them via existing ci-failure-fix-loop.yml infrastructure
feedback_loop_to_agents.encouragement_oriented_fix_suggestion: Bot comment: 'ℹ Consider pinning UPSTREAM.json to last-known-good SHA <X>. Manual review needed before re-vendoring.' (Not blocking; agent decides.)

rollback_mechanism.atomic: Revert the sync PR → UPSTREAM.json restored → next nightly retries from clean state
rollback_mechanism.manual: Edit UPSTREAM.json.commit_sha to last-good SHA + re-run install.sh; cron will retry from there

./tools/hook-bootstrap/uninstall.sh → reverses hooks + .envrc; tools/agent-skills/ preserved unless prompt answered y
.github/workflows/sync-agent-skills.yml workflow_dispatch run → on no-drift = green; on drift = PR opened
